verses.1: And moreover, I fed them with manna in the wilderness, with bread, as David said, and they ate the bread of His angels, the food of the living. And all this I did for them, so that they might serve me in righteousness and uprightness.
verses.2: But they did not serve me, and I also tested them, says the Lord who rules over all; and they rejected me and walked in what was not right before me.
verses.3: And I also, according to their deeds, requited them, and according to their works I judged them, because they forsook my service and did not walk in my law and in my counsel; and I brought them down to the place of the judgment that is in heaven.
verses.4: And on the earth I cut short their days, because they did not keep my commandments, and I also rejected them.
verses.5: And as for you, O king, you are a man, you who will die and decay; you who are dust will become wood, and wood and dust.
verses.6: And now, do you boast and exalt yourself as one who will never die forever?
verses.7: O man, you who now appear alive, yet whose body will die, says the Lord who rules over all.
verses.8: And if you had kept my word and my commandments, I would have given you as an inheritance the holy city, together with those who did my will, the glorious kings whose dwelling is bright, and whose crowns and thrones are beautiful, of gold and of silver, upon which the pure ones sit.
verses.9: And you would rejoice in that city, which is near, a dwelling for the doers of good.
verses.10: But as for the doers of evil, they shall not be permitted to enter into that city, into which the glorious kings enter.
verses.11: Because they did not keep my word and my law, says the Lord who rules over all.
